decade_prayer_sequence.rubric: Pray once on the large bead before the decade:
Pray ten times on the ten small beads of the decade while contemplating the Mystery:
After the tenth Hail Mary, pray:
Conclude the decade with the Fatima Prayer:

mystery_sets.title: The Joyful Mysteries
mystery_sets.liturgical_note: Traditionally prayed on Mondays, Saturdays, and Sundays of Advent and Christmas.
mystery_sets.theme_summary: Contemplating the Incarnation and hidden life of Christ through the joyful fiat of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

decades.title: The Annunciation
decades.fruit: Humility
decades.scripture_text: And the angel being come in, said unto her: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women... And Mary said: Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done to me according to thy word.
decades.meditation: With humble surrender, the Blessed Virgin welcomes the Archangel Gabriel's message and conceives the Eternal Word by the overshadowing of the Holy Spirit.

decades.title: The Visitation
decades.fruit: Love of Neighbor
decades.scripture_text: And it came to pass, that when Elizabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the infant leaped in her womb. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost: And she cried out with a loud voice, and said: Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb... And Mary said: My soul doth magnify the Lord. And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
decades.meditation: Bearing Christ within her, Mary hastens in charity to serve her cousin Elizabeth, bringing sanctifying joy to the unborn John the Baptist.

artwork.title: The Visitation
artwork.current_location: Princeton University Art Museum, Princeton, New Jersey

decades.title: The Nativity of Our Lord
decades.fruit: Poverty of Spirit and Detachment from the World
decades.scripture_text: And it came to pass, that when they were there, her days were accomplished, that she should be delivered. And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him up in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn... Behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, that shall be to all the people: For, this day, is born to you a Saviour, who is Christ the Lord, in the city of David.
decades.meditation: In the stillness of Bethlehem's night, the Light of the World is born in humble poverty, adored by Mary, Joseph, the angels, and the simple shepherds.

decades.title: The Presentation of Jesus in the Temple
decades.fruit: Obedience and Purity
decades.scripture_text: And after the days of her purification, according to the law of Moses, were accomplished, they carried him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord... Then Simeon took him into his arms, and blessed God, and said: Now thou dost dismiss thy servant, O Lord, according to thy word in peace; Because my eyes have seen thy salvation, Which thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples: A light to the revelation of the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
decades.meditation: In loving obedience to the Law of the Lord, Mary and Joseph offer the Infant Jesus in the Temple, where righteous Simeon recognizes the promised Redeemer.

artwork.title: Presentation of Jesus in the Temple

decades.title: The Finding of Jesus in the Temple
decades.fruit: Joy in Finding Jesus and True Piety
decades.scripture_text: And it came to pass, that, after three days, they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, hearing them, and asking them questions. And all that heard him were astonished at his wisdom and his answers... And he said to them: How is it that you sought me? did you not know, that I must be about my father's business?... And his mother kept all these words in her heart.
decades.meditation: After three days of sorrowful searching, Mary and Joseph rejoice to find the twelve-year-old Jesus in His Father's house, illuminating the teachers of Israel with divine wisdom.

artwork.title: Christ among the Doctors
artwork.current_location: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D.C.

mystery_sets.title: The Luminous Mysteries
mystery_sets.liturgical_note: Traditionally prayed on Thursdays (The Mysteries of Light, introduced by Pope St. John Paul II in 2002).
mystery_sets.theme_summary: Contemplating the public ministry of Christ as the Light of the World, from the Jordan to the Upper Room.

decades.title: The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan
decades.fruit: Openness to the Holy Spirit
decades.scripture_text: And Jesus being baptized, forthwith came out of the water: and lo, the heavens were opened to him: and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him. And behold a voice from heaven, saying: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
decades.meditation: Descending into the waters of the Jordan to sanctify them, Christ is anointed by the Holy Spirit and proclaimed the Beloved Son of the Eternal Father.

decades.title: The Wedding Feast at Cana
decades.fruit: To Jesus through Mary
decades.scripture_text: And the wine failing, the mother of Jesus saith to him: They have no wine. And Jesus saith to her: Woman, what is that to me and to thee? my hour is not yet come. His mother saith to the waiters: Whatsoever he shall say to you, do ye... This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee; and manifested his glory, and his disciples believed in him.
decades.meditation: At the compassionate intercession of His Mother, Christ changes water into the choicest wine, awakening faith in the hearts of His disciples.

artwork.title: The Marriage at Cana
artwork.current_location: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, Kansas City, Missouri

decades.title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom of God
decades.fruit: Repentance and Trust in God
decades.scripture_text: Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God, And saying: The time is accomplished, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent, and believe the gospel... Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven... Blessed are the clean of heart: for they shall see God.
decades.meditation: Upon the Galilean hillside, Christ proclaims the Beatitudes, calling every soul to conversion of heart, merciful forgiveness, and filial trust in the Father.

artwork.title: The Sermon on the Mount
artwork.current_location: Museum of National History, Frederiksborg Castle, Hillerød, Denmark

decades.title: The Transfiguration
decades.fruit: Desire for Holiness
decades.scripture_text: And whilst he prayed, the shape of his countenance was altered, and his raiment became white and glittering. And behold two men were talking with him. And they were Moses and Elias, appearing in majesty... And a voice came out of the cloud, saying: This is my beloved Son; hear ye him.
decades.meditation: On Mount Tabor, the glory of the Godhead shines forth from the face of Christ, strengthening His Apostles for the coming Passion and revealing our call to transfiguring grace.

artwork.title: The Transfiguration of Christ
artwork.current_location: Church of Our Lady (Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk), Bruges, Belgium

decades.title: The Institution of the Eucharist
decades.fruit: Adoration and Gratitude for the Most Blessed Sacrament
decades.scripture_text: And whilst they were at supper, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and broke: and gave to his disciples, and said: Take ye, and eat. This is my body. And taking the chalice, he gave thanks, and gave to them, saying: Drink ye all of this. For this is my blood of the new testament, which shall be shed for many unto remission of sins.
decades.meditation: Having loved His own unto the end, Christ offers His Body and Blood under the appearances of bread and wine to remain with His Church forever.

mystery_sets.title: The Sorrowful Mysteries
mystery_sets.liturgical_note: Traditionally prayed on Tuesdays, Fridays, and Sundays of Lent.
mystery_sets.theme_summary: Entering into the saving Passion and Death of Our Lord Jesus Christ, by which the world is redeemed.

decades.title: The Agony in the Garden
decades.fruit: Contrition for Sin and Conformity to God's Will
decades.scripture_text: And he was withdrawn away from them a stone's cast; and kneeling down, he prayed, Saying: Father, if thou wilt, remove this chalice from me: but yet not my will, but thine be done. And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, strengthening him. And being in an agony, he prayed the longer. And his sweat became as drops of blood, trickling down upon the ground.
decades.meditation: In the dark stillness of Gethsemane, Christ bears the weight of every human sin, uniting His sacred heart to the Father's redemptive will.

artwork.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives (Christ's Fear of Death)

decades.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
decades.fruit: Purity and Mortification of the Senses
decades.scripture_text: Then therefore Pilate took Jesus, and scourged him... But he was wounded for our iniquities, he was bruised for our sins: the chastisement of our peace was upon him, and by his bruises we are healed.
decades.meditation: Bound to the pillar in silence, the innocent Lamb of God endures cruel blows in reparation for the sins of the flesh and to heal our wounded nature.

decades.title: The Crowning with Thorns
decades.fruit: Moral Courage and Reign of Christ in Our Hearts
decades.scripture_text: And stripping him, they put a scarlet cloak about him. And platting a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand. And bowing the knee before him, they mocked him, saying: Hail, King of the Jews. And spitting upon him, they took the reed, and struck his head.
decades.meditation: Crowned with sharp thorns and mocked by soldiers, the true King of Kings teaches us meekness and courage when enduring the world's contempt.

artwork.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns (La coronación de espinas)

decades.title: The Carrying of the Cross
decades.fruit: Patience in Trials
decades.scripture_text: And bearing his own cross, he went forth to that place which is called Calvary... And as they led him away, they laid hold of one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country; and they laid the cross on him to carry after Jesus. And there followed him a great multitude of people, and of women, who bewailed and lamented him.
decades.meditation: Falling beneath the heavy wood along the Via Dolorosa, Christ exchanges a look of piercing love with His sorrowful Mother, inviting us to take up our daily cross after Him.

artwork.title: Christ Falling on the Way to Calvary (Lo Spasimo di Sicilia)
artwork.medium: Oil on panel transferred to canvas

decades.title: The Crucifixion and Death of Our Lord
decades.fruit: Forgiveness of Injuries and Perseverance in Faith
decades.scripture_text: And when they were come to the place which is called Calvary, they crucified him there... And Jesus said: Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do... And Jesus crying with a loud voice, said: Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit. And saying this, he gave up the ghost.
decades.meditation: Raised upon the Cross of Calvary, Christ pardons His executioners, entrusts us to His Blessed Mother, and pours forth His last breath for the salvation of souls.

mystery_sets.title: The Glorious Mysteries
mystery_sets.liturgical_note: Traditionally prayed on Wednesdays, Sundays of Eastertide, and Sundays of Ordinary Time.
mystery_sets.theme_summary: Rejoicing in the triumph of the Risen Christ, the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, and the heavenly glory of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

decades.title: The Resurrection of Our Lord
decades.fruit: Lively Faith
decades.scripture_text: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed with a white robe: and they were astonished. Who saith to them: Be not affrighted; you seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified: he is risen, he is not here, behold the place where they laid him.
decades.meditation: At dawn on the third day, Christ bursts the bonds of death and rises in radiant majesty, becoming the firstfruits of eternal life for all who believe in Him.

artwork.title: The Resurrection of the Lord (La Resurrección del Señor)
artwork.current_location: Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando, Madrid, Spain

decades.title: The Ascension of Our Lord into Heaven
decades.fruit: Christian Hope and Desire for Heaven
decades.scripture_text: And he led them out as far as Bethania: and lifting up his hands, he blessed them. And it came to pass, whilst he blessed them, he departed from them, and was carried up to heaven, and a cloud received him out of their sight. And they adoring went back into Jerusalem with great joy.
decades.meditation: Forty days after His Resurrection, Christ ascends from the Mount of Olives to the right hand of the Father, preparing a place for us in our heavenly homeland.

artwork.title: The Ascension
artwork.current_location: Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, Massachusetts

decades.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
decades.fruit: Love of God and Gifts of the Holy Spirit
decades.scripture_text: All these were persevering with one mind in prayer with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus... And when the days of the Pentecost were accomplished, they were all together in one place: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a mighty wind coming, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting. And there appeared to them parted tongues as it were of fire, and it sat upon every one of them: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost.
decades.meditation: Gathered in prayer around the Virgin Mary in the Upper Room, the Apostles receive the fire of the Holy Spirit and go forth boldly to preach the Gospel to all nations.

decades.title: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
decades.fruit: Grace of a Happy Death and True Devotion to Mary
decades.scripture_text: Thou art the glory of Jerusalem, thou art the joy of Israel, thou art the honour of our people... All the glory of the king's daughter is within in golden borders, clothed round about with varieties... They shall be brought with gladness and rejoicing: they shall be brought into the temple of the king.
decades.meditation: Having completed the course of her earthly life, the Immaculate Mother of God is taken up body and soul into heavenly glory by the power of her Divine Son.

decades.title: The Coronation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
decades.fruit: Trust in Mary's Intercession and Final Perseverance
decades.scripture_text: And a great sign appeared in heaven: A woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars... I dwelt in the highest places, and my throne is in a pillar of a cloud.
decades.meditation: Exalted above all choirs of angels, the Blessed Virgin Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven and Earth by the Most Holy Trinity, reigning forever as our Mother and Advocate.

artwork.title: The Coronation of the Virgin (La coronación de la Virgen)
